_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored.
_gameServer: Puertos a los que se conecta el cliente. Se comprueban por TCP para saber si el servidor esta arriba: la base de datos responde aunque el servidor este caido, asi que preguntarle a MySQL no sirve. Deben coincidir con LoginserverPort de login/config/Server.ini y GameserverPort de game/config/Server.ini.
_privateKeyFile: RSA private key that decrypts passwords the Worker encrypted. Generate with: npm run keygen
_logFile: El agente corre bajo el Programador de tareas, que descarta stdout. Sin este archivo, una falla no deja rastro. Rota a .1 al superar logMaxBytes.
_pollIntervalMs: How often to look for pending jobs. 5s is responsive enough for a purchase and trivial load on Firestore.
_statusIntervalMs: How often to publish server status for the website to show.
_maxAttempts: A job that fails this many times is parked as 'failed' rather than retried forever.
_accountNamePattern: Must agree with the Worker's validation. The C4 client will not send anything longer than 14 characters.
